name: tesla-clips
title: Tesla Clips
description: Manage Tesla dashcam and Sentry clips — merge split recordings or remove merged outputs.
author: TurboCoder13

commands.name: tesla-clips
commands.title: Tesla Clips
commands.description: Scan Tesla clip folders, merge split recordings, or remove merged outputs.

preferences.name: defaultSourcePath
preferences.title: Default Source Folder
preferences.description: Used when no Finder folders are selected.

preferences.name: outputRootPath
preferences.title: Output Root Folder
preferences.description: Optional. If empty, merged files are written to each event folder under merged/.

preferences.name: ffmpegPath
preferences.title: ffmpeg Binary
preferences.description: Path to ffmpeg executable used for concatenation. If unresolved, common macOS locations are auto-detected.

preferences.name: overwriteExisting
preferences.label: Overwrite Existing Merged Files
preferences.title: Overwrite Existing Merged Files
preferences.description: If enabled, existing merged output files are replaced. Source split clips are not deleted.

preferences.name: deleteSourceSegmentsAfterMerge
preferences.label: Delete Original Split Clips After Merge
preferences.title: Delete Original Split Clips After Merge
preferences.description: Delete source split clips only when a merged output is created successfully.

preferences.name: openOutputWhenDone
preferences.label: Open Output Folder After Merge
preferences.title: Open Output Folder After Merge
preferences.description: Open the first output folder in Finder after completion.

preferences.name: enableDebugLogging
preferences.label: Enable Debug Logging
preferences.title: Enable Debug Logging
preferences.description: Emit verbose logs in Raycast command logs.

scripts.validate: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
